column1: # backup area: capellactl backup tests ported to cbctl (branch mm--port-backup)

columns, latest per bucket newest first with ID last, per-bucket list, JSON bucketName and the empty 'no backups' message; cbctl tables have no S.NO column
POST to the bucket's backups, 'backup of orders: ready' progress and 'of orders is ready', --no-wait 'started (--no-wait)'
failed backup exits 1 'backup of orders ended failed'; unknown bucket refused with no writes (cbctl not-found exit 3, documented)
'deletes cycle ... with 2 backups of orders'; wrong typed bucket name cancels with no writes; right name one DELETE removes both backups of the cycle and keeps users
wrong typed name at a terminal cancels ('cancelled; nothing was restored') with no writes; no terminal exits 4
every restore flag in the exact POST body; 'into nova-dr-01' and 'overwrites newer documents (--force-updates)'

turned-off target exits 4 'nova-dr-01 is turned off' with no writes

managed set: plan line text, POST body with the defaults, file entry with the defaults as the bucket's last key, plan clean afterwards
terminal without flags asks day, start hour, incremental, retention, cost-optimized; POST body has the answers

undeclared schedule not changed by plan, shown by drift; sync records it and apply is clean; a UI change shows startAt in drift and apply restores it; a deleted schedule is recreated by apply

columns, newest first with ID last, first row date/time, -o json ids, 'no backups' when empty, no writes; no S.NO column

PUT body retention 2160, 'is now kept 90 days (was 30 days)', unknown id 'backup nope of nova-dev-01 not found' (cbctl exit 3 for not found)
wrong typed cluster name cancels with no writes; right name one DELETE and the backup is gone
'all data is replaced with the backup of 2026-10-28 02:00 UTC', wrong name cancels with no writes; no terminal without --yes exits 4
POST body crossRegionRestorePreference, 'restore of nova-dev-01: complete', 'cluster nova-dev-01: healthy', 'restored cluster nova-dev-01 from the backup of ...'
'no restores' when empty, restores columns and row with complete and the snapshot time, regions column and us-west-2

plan line, options read before the write, exact PUT body, file entry and Capella retention
managed schedule set and backup list on a free-tier cluster exit 4 'free-tier clusters have no backups'; no writes, file unchanged

all seven cases refused with no writes and the file unchanged; values the cluster's options do not permit block the plan (cbctl exit 4, a blocked plan), malformed flags and file-invalid values exit 3; 400d stands in for 120d (the fake permits 365 days)
every/keep/copy regions lines and JSON maximumRetention and regions (fake values: 1 day to 365 days); no writes
'has no backup schedule', summary line with first-at time and copies, 'next backup: ', JSON interval/copyToRegions/nextBackup
undeclared cluster schedule: plan makes no change (lists it as unmanaged), drift lists it, apply --prune deletes it (one DELETE)
403 on cloudsnapshotbackupschedule: sync warns about the Organization Owner/Project Owner role and keeps the file's schedule
sync writes a Capella-made schedule (interval, retention, startTime 02:00, copy region) and the next apply makes no writes
